// IGeometry that already exposes an indexed triangle set: random access to
// faces and vertex positions by typed index.
interface ITriangulatedGeometry3D
    inherits IMesh3D
{
    TriangleCount(x: Self): Integer;
    FaceAt(x: Self, face: FaceIndex): TriangleFace;
    PositionAt(x: Self, vertex: VertexIndex): Point3D;
}
